title: Migrate Training domain routes and session management
summary_zh: 將 Training 的十四個 trainer route decorators 移入可注入的 domain router，保留既有 session persistence 與 persona-training port 行為，並以 V3 evidence contract 取代 V2 不完整交付。

replacement_lineage.reason: V2 的功能實作已驗證，但沒有本 task 所需的 immutable evidence-manifest artifact contract。

owned: Training APIRouter endpoint ownership and dependency injection
TrainingSessionService validation and trainer-seed bridge extraction
BFF composition-root registration and Training router ownership test
not_changing: Training Session read-store and persistence behaviour

contracts.router_ownership: All fourteen /api/v1/trainer GET and POST endpoints are registered by create_training_router; main.py has no remaining trainer route decorator.
contracts.composition: main.py imports and includes create_training_router using existing BFF ports, without a reverse import from training/ to main.py.
contracts.session_preservation: TrainingSessionService retains the established validation, session status, replay, rapid-evaluation, and trainer-seed bridge behaviour while resolving the existing read store per request.
contracts.failure_semantics: The router preserves the established authentication-before-validation order and BFF error-envelope semantics.

verification.details: The standalone ownership suite passed 2/2; trainer session passed 27/27; rapid-eval, dialog, and controls passed 23/23; preview and replay passed 38/38 (90 tests total).

review_handoff.exact_pr_head_authority: The governed ai-status handoff freezes REVIEW_PR and REVIEW_HEAD_SHA for this committed manifest; the canonical binding is authoritative because a committed manifest cannot self-reference the commit that contains it.
required_checks: verify all fourteen trainer endpoints are registered by training/router.py
verify main.py has no /api/v1/trainer decorators and includes the injected router
verify training/ has no reverse import of main.py
verify existing Training Session persistence and persona-training ports were not changed
verify the focused Training router and contract test commands pass
approve the exact PR head frozen with this manifest path
